facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, with MTN Foundation Uganda and Centenary Technology Services, is implementing a Shs4 billion, three-year programme of four regional digital innovation hubs at public universities plus the Nakawa hub, expected to give over 20,000 students and community members digital skills training; the second hub was handed over at Busitema University.
facts.system: MTN ACE Spark Innovation Hub programme
